intent: Collect exact and complementary painted subject candidates for final user review, no app publication

art.title: Saint Emidius Consecrated Bishop by Pope Saint Marcellus
art.hold: Catalog specifically names San Marcello Papa. Physical setting Ascoli Piceno; accession photo full-frame and quality not inspected.

art.title: Pope Saint Marcellus I
art.hold: Ascoli Piceno cathedral mural not oil canvas; photo rights and crop remain unverified.

art.title: Enthroned Virgin with Child between Saints Vincent of Saragossa and Anastasius
art.hold: Church's official inventory confirms both saints kneeling with the Virgin; exact photography, legal rights, native full altarpiece crop not certified; artist painting not yet a canonical 383.

art.title: Saint Titus, Bishop of Crete
art.hold: Vatican Museums official Room XVIII catalogue item 11 names Titus, notes Latin vestments and signed back. Vatican museum photograph rights not established, not Western oil painting, aesthetic hold.

leads.artist: Giuseppe Sforza Perini after Luigi Agricola
leads.title: Saints Caius and Soter, Popes and Martyrs
leads.hold: Historically exact combined iconography, but etching is a PRINT, not a painting; do not close strict painted source coverage.

leads.title: Pope Soter in Sistine Chapel Papal Cycle
leads.hold: Independent painting of one pope but not Caius. Original art could be style-exception; photographic copyright hold.

leads.artist: Giovan Battista da Ossona / Giovan Battista Ferrario (attribution under research)
leads.title: Martyrdom of Saint Pancras
leads.hold: Historic silver-gelatin photo belongs to separate archival record; institutional photo rights unknown. Recent scholarship questions Giovan Battista Ossona name. Does not depict Nereus, Achilleus and Domitilla in same original.

leads.title: Baptism of Saint Pancras
leads.medium: tempera painting on panel, fifteenth century
leads.hold: Alternate independent depiction at Museo Bandini, photo quality and rights unverified; does not complete four-member painting.

leads.artist: Giovanni Battista Crespi (Cerano), Pier Francesco Mazzucchelli (Morazzone), Giulio Cesare Procaccini
leads.title: The Martyrdom of Saints Rufina and Secunda (Quadro delle tre mani)
leads.hold: Important: EXACT Roman Rufina and Secunda, NOT different Seville Justa and Rufina. The seven brothers are not included; historical SevenBrothers.jpg still identity-unverified. Photo rights and original crop pending.

leads.title: Madonna and Child with Pope Saint Victor I, Eustace, Andrew, and Cristanziano
leads.hold: Exact Pope Victor I not St Victor of Milan. Diocesan Museum Ascoli Piceno; still no Innocent I or complete combined feast painting. Art/photo rights unverified.

leads.artist: Follower of Pietro da Cortona; alternatively attributed to Fabio Cristofani
leads.title: Pope Urban VIII Consecrates Saint Peter's Basilica
leads.medium: painted tapestry cartoon on cardboard, 1671, 305×500 cm
leads.hold: Physical painted preparatory cartoon at Palazzo Barberini inv 2261; photo archives 99432/99433 are reproductions of the same original. No evidence of St Paul's dedication depicted; cannot close joint feast.

leads.title: Urban VIII Dedicates Saint Peter's Basilica
leads.hold: Different physical art object from Barberini painted cartoon, Vatican Museums reproduction © Governatorato; tapestries are not oil paintings. Does not include St Paul Outside the Walls.

guards: Do not auto-accept print, tapestry or sculpture as a painting
Do not represent multiple separate paintings as a single original depicting the whole multi-saint feast
Do not equate 22 Jan Vincent of Saragossa with another namesake or Roman Rufina and Secunda with Seville Justa and Rufina
Sistine pope series photographic material is not source rights certification
Vatican icon/photo rights are still unverified
When a new feast has multiple exact named originals, preserve them for user selection and later eligible approved rotation only
